title: Ravenwolf's Cobblemon Create LITE
description: A fork of Ravenwolf's Cobblemon Create for lower-end devices.
body:
The "Lite" version of Ravenwolf's Cobblemon Create. Basically a version for lower-end devices.

A modpack that combines Cobblemon with Create and a few exploration/adventure mods along the way. Includes a few QoL and Aesthetic mods to enhance immersion without straying too far from simple vanilla Minecraft principles. Perfect combination for Cobblemon/Create SMP with friends!

See more at the full page here: https://modrinth.com/modpack/ravenwolfs-cobblemon-create
